title: The Fiscal Deficit, Explained

segments.say: Think of a family. If it spends more than it earns in a year, it must borrow the difference. For a government, that gap is the fiscal deficit.
In exam words: fiscal deficit is total spending minus total receipts, not counting borrowing. It is how much the government must borrow that year.
Say the government spends a hundred and earns eighty from taxes and other receipts. It must borrow twenty. That twenty is the fiscal deficit.

anim.title: Three deficits
items: Revenue deficit: day-to-day spending above revenue income
Primary deficit: fiscal deficit minus interest payments

segments.say: Two cousins: the revenue deficit, when day-to-day spending exceeds income, and the primary deficit, which is the fiscal deficit minus interest on old loans.

right.title: Can hurt
items: Less money left for private loans

segments.say: Is a deficit bad? Borrowing to build roads can pay back. But too much borrowing means big interest bills and less money left for private business.

items.text: Act amended: debt as an anchor
Path to below 4.5% of GDP by 2025-26

segments.say: The Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management Act of two thousand three set limits. In twenty twenty-one, the government set a path to bring the deficit below four and a half percent of GDP by twenty twenty-five, twenty-six.
For GS Three: fiscal deficit is the year's borrowing need, primary deficit leaves out interest, and the FRBM Act keeps watch.

sources: Union Budget documents, 'Budget at a Glance' (indiabudget.gov.in): definitions of revenue deficit, fiscal deficit (total expenditure minus revenue receipts and non-debt capital receipts) and primary deficit (fiscal deficit minus interest payments)
Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management Act, 2003, and its 2018 amendment (Finance Act 2018): debt and fiscal deficit targets
Budget Speech 2021-22, para on fiscal consolidation: fiscal deficit to be brought below 4.5% of GDP by 2025-26

options: Total spending minus receipts excluding borrowing
quiz.why: It is the year's borrowing need.

quiz.q: Primary deficit is fiscal deficit minus…
quiz.why: It shows borrowing apart from paying for old loans.

quiz.q: Which law sets India's fiscal limits?
quiz.why: Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management Act.
